en: Illustrated panoramic view of a mountainous landscape around a large lake, labeled with place names. The lake (Lago di Garda) is surrounded by towns and valleys such as Riva, Arco, Nago, Torbole, Tenno, and others. Mountain peaks including Mt. Altissimo and Mt. Baldo are indicated, with rivers and roads drawn and named, giving the image the style of a bird's‑eye tourist map.
